thread:
mina: Noticing a new pattern: websocket sessions survive TLS renegotiation at the edge and the backend keeps a zombie entry. Dashboard shows stable "active" count but traffic is lower.

owen: I saw that too — we get `socket closed` at the edge but backend never gets FIN. Suspect proxy library swallowing half-close on renegotiate.

infra-bot: alert created (#ws-zombie-sessions) - threshold 50 zombies in 10m.

tara: Short repro: trigger TLS rehandshake from client -> connection resets at edge -> reconnect with same resume id -> backend accepts resume while old session lingers. Small log: `edge: conn_reset id=zx12`, `backend: resume accepted id=zx12` but no GC.

ryan: UX pain: console only shows `streams.active` and `streams.total`. We need `streams.zombie` and an eviction trend so SRE can see correlation with TLS events.

mina: Proposed mitigation: add server-side `Resume-Cooldown` header on forced eviction and mark session `zombie=true` so billing excludes it immediately. Add metric `streams.evicted.zombie`.

owen: Implementation note: when we mark zombie, return `X-Resume-Cooldown: 45s` and emit `RESUME_AFTER_ZOMBIE` log if a resume arrives. Also add server-side gated backoff: if resume before cooldown, respond 503 with `Retry-After`.

tara: Can we also add a tiny in-console experiment: when zombie metrics spike, show a scaffolding card that recommends enabling `zombie-evict-canary` with defaults.

ryan: Billing must switch to `streams.billable` metric that ignores `zombie=true`. I can coordinate with billing to watch delta during canary.

mina: I'll open PR with feature flag `zombie_evict_v1` and a lightweight watchdog that tombstones these entries after `zombie_grace` window. Will include metrics and headers.

owen: Please add an SDK note: on receiving `Retry-After` or `Resume-Cooldown`, SDKs should back off before reattempting resume. Mobile clients are the main offenders.

infra-bot: deploy started (canary cluster) - proxy@zombie-evict-20260321. ETA 18m.

mina: TL;DR: add zombie metric, return Resume-Cooldown header, tombstone stale sessions, dashboard card for canary, billing watch. We'll iterate after synthetic probe results.
